# Jacopo Ottaviani — Data Journalist
# https://jacopoottaviani.com

## About
Jacopo Ottaviani is an Italian data journalist and computer scientist.
He is Chief Data Officer at Code for Africa (member of the ICFJ Plus alliance),
the continent's largest network of civic technology and data journalism labs.
He produces investigative stories combining data analysis, code, cartography and AI,
published internationally in The Guardian, Der Spiegel, El País, Internazionale,
Daily Maverick, Reuters, Columbia Journalism Review, and UNDP.
He is a former ICFJ Knight Fellow and trains and mentors journalists and
communicators worldwide.

## AI in his work
- Uses AI and agentic workflows (Claude) at every stage of his data journalism:
  research, scraping, analysis, prototyping and maintenance of projects,
  while reporting, verification and editorial judgement stay human.
- Writes a first-person essay series on AI and data journalism for the
  Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism, University of Oxford:
  - "From prompts to loops: How AI entered every stage of my data journalism" (2026)
    https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/news/prompts-loops-how-ai-entered-every-stage-my-data-journalism
  - "From weeks of work to days: How I rebuilt two data journalism projects with AI" (2026)
    https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/news/weeks-work-days-how-i-rebuilt-two-data-journalism-projects-ai
- Runs workshops on using AI in data journalism: https://jacopoottaviani.com/workshops.html

## Selected projects
- Italia Fragile — Italy's hydrogeological fragility, built with Claude Fable 5 and agentic loops
- Africa Mining Watch — satellite imagery and machine learning mapping illegal mining in Africa
- JuxMaps — historical maps laid over eight cities (from the Plus AI Sprint)
- Africa Infra Watch — Africa's infrastructure pipeline and who finances it
- Map Makoko — community mapping of Lagos' floating settlement (Sigma Award 2021)
- E-Waste Republic — electronic waste in Ghana (Lorenzo Natali Media Prize)
- The Migrants' Files, PatrieGalere, StradeMortali, Lungs of the Earth, Generation E

## Expertise
- Data journalism and investigative reporting
- AI in journalism and agentic AI workflows for newsrooms
- Machine learning on satellite imagery
- Interactive data visualization
- Digital cartography
- Computational linguistics
- International development

- Open data and open-source tools for newsrooms
- Journalism training and mentoring
- Python, JavaScript, R
